description: This file defines the Layout annotation class used in Drupal for layout plugins, including properties for layout metadata and a method to retrieve layout definitions.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: Defines a Layout annotation object for Drupal layout plugins, including properties for plugin ID, label, description, category, template, theme hook, resources, regions, default region, and class, along with a method to get the layout definition.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a new LayoutDefinition object based on the annotation's definition property.
